card.title: Account
card.exportHint: All of your family's data in a JSON file (children, dogs, log, contracts, scores). Links to pictures and videos work for about an hour.

lastParentLines.intro: You're the only parent in the family, so the WHOLE family will be deleted:
lastParentLines.records: with all contracts (signatures), the care log, scores, and the dogs' pictures and videos,
lastParentLines.devices: and every device (the children's too) will be signed out.

otherParentStaysLines.account: Only your account will be deleted and your devices signed out.
otherParentStaysLines.family: The family, the children and the dogs stay with the other parent.

card.exportFirst: Tip: export your data before deleting.

deleteErrors.protected: This account can't be deleted in the app.
deleteErrors.throttled: Too many wrong passwords. Please try again in 15 minutes.
deleteErrors.invalid: Enter your password and confirm the deletion.
deleteErrors.unknown: We don't know whether the deletion went through — check by signing in again.
deleteErrors.server: Deleting didn't work. Nothing was deleted — please try again.

exportErrors.too_large: There's too much data to export in the app. Please contact support.
exportErrors.too_large_to_share: The export is too large to share as text. Exporting to a file is on its way — until then, please contact support.
exportErrors.throttled: You can export three times an hour. Please try again later.
exportErrors.offline: Can't reach the server. Please try again.
exportErrors.server: The export didn't work. Please try again.

deletionForm.irreversible: Deletion is immediate and can't be undone.
